purpose: Reference scaffolding for cat-22 regulatory compliance UCs. Authors adapt per regulation and clause — do not paste verbatim.

ta.name: Splunk Enterprise / ES summary indexing
ta.scope: Scheduled searches writing to index=audit_evidence with regulation/clause tagging

kfps.scenario: Authorised internal control testing — GRC or internal audit exercises the control during scheduled evidence collection.
kfps.distinguish: Service accounts tagged compliance_ops=true; active entry in regulation-specific exception register.

kfps.scenario: External assessor sampling — QSA or regulator pulls samples that temporarily spike audit_evidence volume.
kfps.distinguish: Engagement letter dates in compliance programme calendar.
kfps.suppress: Time-bound exception keyed on assessor_org and valid_until.

kfps.scenario: Planned maintenance affecting control telemetry — CAB change pauses or reshapes log ingestion.
kfps.distinguish: Active change record with affected CI list matches index/sourcetype gap.

kfps.scenario: Third-party processor under contract — BAA/DPA-covered vendor generates expected cross-boundary events.
kfps.distinguish: Vendor ID in signed agreement lookup; not an unauthorised data transfer.
kfps.suppress: Processor exception register keyed on vendor_id and valid_until.

troubleshooting.cause: Summary-index action disabled or wrong marker field
troubleshooting.fix: Verify saved search actions and action.summary_index._name in savedsearches.conf
